title: Tags
description: The tags module displays the current state of tags in dwl.

num-tags.label: Num tags
num-tags.doc: The number of tags that should be displayed. Max 32. This should match the number of tags configured in dwl.
num-tags.description: The number of tags that should be displayed. Max 32. This should match the number of tags configured in dwl.

tag-labels.label: Tag labels
tag-labels.doc: The label to display for each tag.
tag-labels.description: The label to display for each tag.

hide-vacant.label: Hide vacant
hide-vacant.doc: If set to true, tags without clients and that are not active will be hidden.
hide-vacant.description: If set to true, tags without clients and that are not active will be hidden.

disable-click.label: Disable click
disable-click.doc: If set to false, you can left-click to set focused tag. Right-click to toggle tag focus. If set to true this behaviour is disabled.
disable-click.description: If set to false, you can left-click to set focused tag. Right-click to toggle tag focus. If set to true this behaviour is disabled.

expand.label: Fill empty space
expand.doc: Enables this module to consume all left over space dynamically.
expand.description: Stretch the module to use all the free space left in its section.
